description: Dead-man for the per-camera motion-staleness monitor (binary_sensor.camera_motion_stale / sensor.camera_motion_stale, the recorder-query script). Both its alert and the fleet-wide pipeline check read this sensor's attributes and silently evaluate 'no fault' when it dies. 60 min clears restart windows. RE-ASSERTS hourly (:59) while dead (restart-wipe guard). Covers BOTH death modes: command-level death (state unavailable/unknown) AND the script's fail() path, which emits valid JSON with exit 0 - the sensor stays numeric but its 'error' attribute goes non-null (the binary reads 'off', so a state trigger alone would miss the likeliest death mode: a recorder-DB failure). Added 2026-08-17.

data.title: 📷 Motion-staleness monitor down
data.message: The per-camera motion-staleness monitor has been in an error state for 60+ min. Per-camera staleness and the fleet pipeline check are both blind while it is down. sensor.camera_motion_stale error: {{ state_attr('sensor.camera_motion_stale','error') or 'sensor missing entirely' }}. {{ now().strftime('%b %-d %-I:%M %p') }}.
